# `endswith`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
endswith(left, right)
```

Returns a boolean. The value is True if left ends with right.
Returns NULL if either input expression is NULL. Otherwise, returns False.
Both left or right must be of STRING or BINARY type.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- endswith, example 1
> SELECT endswith('Spark SQL', 'SQL');
true
```

```sql
-- endswith, example 2
> SELECT endswith('Spark SQL', 'Spark');
false
```

```sql
-- endswith, example 3
> SELECT endswith('Spark SQL', null);
NULL
```

```sql
-- endswith, example 4
> SELECT endswith(x'537061726b2053514c', x'537061726b');
false
```

```sql
-- endswith, example 5
> SELECT endswith(x'537061726b2053514c', x'53514c');
true
```
